profile.headline: Software Developer In Test at General Motors
profile.summary: I am a passionate Software Developer in Test with knowledge in automation, cloud technologies, and programming. I am focused on Java, Python, C#, C/C++, SQL, Azure, AWS  and much more. My goal is to use new technologies and to grow with a company that I believe in and enjoy.

positions.title: Software Developer In Test
positions.description:
•	Proficient in automation and testing frameworks, tools, and services
•       Experience with various technologies such as Selenium, Cucumber, TestNG, Docker, and Kubernetes
•	Wrote several hundred API test scripts for applications and databases
•	Performed DevOps duties by creating and maintaining the CI/CD pipeline within the Azure DevOps platform
•	Presented across several internal organizations, directors, and managers about new technologies and testing methodologies
•	Worked in an agile environment with fast paced scrums to bring continuous improvements to software
•       Future Digital Products engineer for General Motors

positions.title: Software Engineering Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Create and fix drivers programmed in C#  
• Experience with technologies using TCP/IP, UDP, serial, and infrared signals.  
• Use debugging techniques to evaluate issues related to the device, network, or driver
• Perform code reviews and maintain projects with Atlassian Tool Suite
• Work with external teams to validate system test plans and results

positions.title: Software Engineer Spring Co-op
positions.description:
• Improve several drivers in C# to increase performance and meet customer needs
• Communicated with several electronic device manufacturers to add new functionalities 
• Work with DevOps to provide documented test and release packages 
• Setup test systems using third party products
• Document and research issues discovered
